# HTTPS decryption test set for .github/scripts/capture-gates.py (gate I3:
# at least 95% of the sites that answer directly must also answer, with the
# same status class, through the tunnel's HTTPS decryption, and the exchange
# must be in the capture). One host per line; https://HOST/ is fetched once.
